title: Player Who Returned 10,000 Years Later
altTitles: The Player Who Returned After 10,000 Years
1万年ぶりに帰還したプレイヤー
O Jogador Que Retornou 10.000 Anos Depois
เพลเยอร์ผู้กลับมาในรอบหมื่นปี
Người Chơi Trở Lại Sau 10.000 Năm
Le Joueur Revenu 10 000 Ans Plus Tard
description: One day, Kang Woo suddenly falls into Hell. With nothing but an overwhelming desire to survive and a mysterious predation ability, he begins devouring demons and growing stronger through the countless layers of Hell. Over ten thousand years, he becomes powerful enough that even the seven Archdukes bow before him. But Hell has nothing enjoyable left for him, so he desperately wants to return to Earth. After enduring ten thousand years, Kang Woo finally returns to the human world, only to discover that Earth has changed and that he must once again adapt to a world filled with Gates, monsters, and powerful players.
author: Butterfly Valley
